subject: Deployment environment tradeoffs & compliance evidence — next actions
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@medsentry.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsentry.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment environment tradeoffs & compliance evidence — next actions

Hi Claire / Jordan — great call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the right deployment choice for your triage/PHI workflow.

Recap (what we heard)
- Workload: batch imports of historical PHI + near-real-time triage at peak bursts ~50 rps, sustained 3–5 rps.
- Latency target: 100–200ms p50 for inference endpoints.
- Compliance constraints: must sign BAA, need SOC2 Type II evidence, security team will require network isolation controls and an audit window for logs.
- Preference stated: initial bias toward Private VPC (customer-managed networking) but open to Dedicated if procurement/ops favors it.

Decision factors to validate
- Data residency & isolation: will you allow host-managed KMS or require customer KMS/HSM?
- Audit scope: SOC2 report acceptable coverage (in-scope for Redwood infra + deployment controls)?
- Retention and purge: retention windows for logs and user data (we propose 90 days default for logs, configurable).
- On-prem: feasibility is possible but adds 6–10 week runway for installation and validation.

Attachments
- Redwood_Deployment_Matrix_v1.pdf (PDF) — quick matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC across security, latency, procurement, and cost.

Asks / next steps
1) Please confirm whether your security team requires customer-managed KMS/HSM or if a Redwood-managed KMS with CMEK is acceptable.
2) Share the most recent SOC2 Type II report or a secure link to it.
3) If you can, provide a preferred audit window (dates/quarter) and an initial procurement SLA target (target go-live date).
4) I’ll draft a BAA and circulate to your legal once we confirm the route; would you prefer DocuSign or a PDF for redlines?

Proposed timeline (if Private VPC chosen)
- Evidence collection: 1–2 weeks
- BAA/legal review: 1 week
- Provisioning & networking validation: 2–3 weeks
- Cutover/validation: 1 week

If Dedicated is chosen, provisioning quicker (1–2 weeks) but we may need additional controls for strict network egress and KMS.

I’ve looped in Marissa (CS lead) and Karthik (infra/devrel) to help with the technical questionnaire and provisioning plan.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up with your security lead next week to walk through the matrix.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwood.com)

---
Attachment: Redwood_Deployment_Matrix_v1.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@medsentry.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsentry.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment environment tradeoffs & compliance evidence — next actions

Thanks Sean — great summary. A few clarifications from our side:

Answers to your asks
- KMS: Our security team prefers customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS with Customer Master Keys). For on-prem we can discuss HSM connectors but that’s a later phase.
- SOC2: I can share our SOC2 Type II 2025 report via a secure drive link (see attachment).
- Audit window: we usually request a rolling 12-month log retention with the ability to export on 7-day notice; for the initial audit we’ll request access to 90 days of logs.
- BAA: DocuSign is preferred by our legal ops.

Preference on route
- Security ops is leaning Private VPC for full network isolation. Procurement will weigh cost/speed — if Dedicated can be scoped to customer KMS + VPC peering we may accept it.

Attachments
- MediSentry_Security_Summary.pdf (PDF) — high-level controls and contacts.
- MediSentry_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF) — secure link inside the PDF (we’ve removed sensitive sections; we can provide full under NDA).

Next actions from us
- I’ll introduce you to our security lead (cc: Jordan) for a short technical sync.
- We’ll confirm procurement target by EOD Friday; tentatively aiming for a mid-October pilot.

On the technical sync, can Marissa or Karthik cover the network/VPC peering options and the KMS/HSM integration patterns?

—Claire
Claire Dunn
Security Program Manager, MediSentry
(claire.dunn@medsentry.com)

---
Attachment: MediSentry_Security_Summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
Attachment: MediSentry_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (PDF, link to secure drive)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@medsentry.com>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@medsentry.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment environment tradeoffs & compliance evidence — next actions

Marissa / Karthik — looped you in to coordinate the technical follow-up and make the BAA flow predictable. I sketched a recommended decision tree in the attached questionnaire and propose we align on the following owners & actions:

Owner assignments
- Marissa (CS): run pilot project plan, coordinate validation tests and end-to-end acceptance criteria.
- Karthik (Infra/Product): own the KMS/CMEK design and VPC peering options; build minimal configuration checklist for Dedicated and Private VPC.
- Sean (AE): own procurement timeline and BAA circulation.

Immediate asks for next 48 hours
1) Karthik — can you prepare a 1-page KMS integration pattern (customer-managed KMS via AWS + optional HSM flow) and note any features not currently supported?
2) Marissa — can you draft a simple validation test plan for latency/p50 and token billing checks (small harness we can run in pilot)?
3) Claire / Jordan — if you can sign a short NDA we can provide the unredacted SOC2 and a sample BAA draft. Otherwise we’ll provide partial redacted evidence as Claire sent.

Proposed timeline (updated)
- 0–3 business days: KMS pattern + validation checklist + BAA draft circulation
- 3–10 business days: evidence handoff and security sync call (we propose Tue 9/7 at 10am PT)
- 10–30 days: provisioning & pilot (Private VPC) or faster if Dedicated chosen.

Attachment: MediSentry_Infra_Questionnaire.xlsx (Excel) — I filled in our side of the matrix; please add your expected constraints.

I’ll prepare the DocuSign BAA draft but will hold until Claire confirms DocuSign as preferred.

-Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(sean.gallagher@redwood.com)

- We will default to Private VPC for the pilot; procurement is still evaluating cost delta vs Dedicated and will flag any blocker by EOD Friday.
- SOC2: full report available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMediSentrySOC2 (read-only).
